title: Interregional DR dry run with point-in-time restore audit
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: run a full interregional active->passive DR dry run that includes a point-in-time restore (PITR) audit against production-like snapshots, validate token/KV reconciliation, exercise circuit-breakers and load-shedding policies, and produce an operator-runbook with artifact-backed proof (checksums/screenshots/log clips). This ticket coordinates cross-team ops: serving runtime, infra, console, and oncall. The intent is to prove that a passive region can be promoted and serve within SLOs for a defined workload profile while preserving data correctness and enabling a clear rollback path.
objectives: Perform a PITR from the last 24h snapshot into the passive region and validate integrity via fingerprinting
Run traffic siphon to passive region with progressively increasing percentiles (0%->10%->50%->100%) while exercising circuit-breakers
Validate tokenstore reconciliation and session continuity for long-lived chats and streaming sessions
Measure SLO impact (p50/p95/p99 latency and error rate) during promotion and steady-state on passive
Produce operator artifacts: snapshot checksums, reconciliation diff report, screenshots of dashboards and PR links
success_criteria: Passive region promoted and serving 100% of traffic within the defined promotion window (<= 12m) for the small-scale workload
No data loss observed for the validated key ranges and tokenstore sessions (fingerprint delta <= 0.01% for KV checks)
Circuit-breaker hit rates and load-shedding events are logged and behave according to configured hysteresis
Automated post-run verification completes and uploads reports to Confluence and the run artifacts bucket
preconditions: Active-region snapshots created and cataloged for the target PITR timestamp
Passive region has compatible runtime version and kernel/profile (runtime-1.22) and warm GPU pool
Oncall rotation assigned and Slack incident channel pre-created
Backups and snapshot manifests have been checksumed and stored in s3://redwood-dr-artifacts/2026-03
steps: 1) Announce drill: post to #oncall and create incident channel with subject 'DR Dry Run ENG-406001'
2) Quiesce background batch jobs in active region that mutate KV (5m window)
3) Capture final WAL segment and snapshot manifest (PITR target) and compute snapshot checksum
4) Restore snapshot to isolated passive cluster (follow restore-harness v2), record restore logs
5) Run integrity verifier: run kv-fingerprint across primary key prefixes and compare with active snapshot checksums
6) Reconcile tokenstore: run token-replay for a 2h sample and assert session continuity for <= 99% of sampled sessions
7) Start traffic siphon: route 0%->10%->50%->100% with 10 minute ramps; monitor latency/error SLOs
8) Intentionally trigger a circuit-breaker calibration test by injecting synthetic tail latency in passive region and confirm fallback to active policy
9) If checks pass, promote passive to active for the experiment; otherwise abort and run rollback plan
10) Run post-run verification: snapshot diff, replay logs, store artifacts, and close incident channel
checklist: Pre-drill runbook ack from oncall (sigs required)
S3 artifact bucket writable and versioned
Restore-harness v2 deployed and smoke-tested in staging
Circuit-breaker config with hysteresis has canary thresholds set
Telemetry dashboards (SLO panels) pinned and recording 1m-resolution metrics
telemetry_checks: Confirm p50/p95/p99 latency baselines from last 7d for route:/generate
Monitor error budget burn rate during promotion (should not exceed 2% of daily budget)
Circuit-breaker trip count and recovery time recorded
rollback_plan: If KV fingerprint delta > 0.1% -> abort promotion, redirect traffic back to active region, and mark incident for forensic snapshot comparison
If SLOs exceed defined thresholds for >10 minutes -> engage partial rollback: reduce traffic to passive to 10% and enable graceful shedding
If tokenstore reconciliation fails for >1% of sessions -> fail promotion and run targeted session backfill scripts
Document rollback steps in incident page and attach affected manifests/PRs
risks: Restore time may exceed promotion window under heavy snapshot sizes
Split-brain risk if both regions accept writes during window — mitigated by write locks and elevation gating
Telemetry blind spots if metrics ingestion lags during failover
Operator error during manual promotion steps — reduce by checklist automation and step confirmations
